caption: The drawing features a large, golden-brown eagle with outstretched wings, occupying the central space against a plain, light background. The eagle’s head faces to its right. It has detailed feathers in various shades of brown and gold, with slightly darker brown shading along the insides and tips of the wings. The eagle’s claws grip a bundle that includes green leafy branches on the left side and three gray arrows on the right side, bound together by a dark band. The eagle's chest displays a shield with a blue upper section containing three white stars, and alternating vertical red and white stripes below. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner containing text.
title: Stern Board
